svg.text: Multi-input: each column with a validity bitmap

g.text: s1-s5: segments; the state carries across them

svg.text: MIDPRICE(3): (highest inHigh + lowest inLow) / 2 over the last 3 valid rows.
Row 3: if any validity bit is 0, the row is null.
Row 6: if any value is NaN, the row is null.
Row 9: NaN with validity bit 1 is still null.
Chunks may cross partitions; segments may cross chunks.
Inputs chunked alike may share one validity bitmap.
